description: This file defines the PolicyAdministrationPointInterface, a Go interface for managing access control policies in the Mattermost server, including methods for initializing, validating, querying, saving, and deleting policies.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the policy administration point and CEL engine.

methods.name: GetPolicyRuleAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attributes of a specified policy for a given action.

methods.name: CheckExpression
methods.description: Checks the validity of a given expression using the CEL engine.

methods.name: ExpressionToVisualAST
methods.description: Converts an expression to a visual abstract syntax tree.

methods.name: NormalizePolicy
methods.description: Normalizes a policy by restoring IDs to names.

methods.name: QueryUsersForExpression
methods.description: Evaluates an expression to find matching users.

methods.name: QueryUsersForResource
methods.description: Finds users matching a resource and action.

methods.name: GetChannelMembersToRemove
methods.description: Retrieves channel members to be removed.

methods.name: GetPoliciesForFieldIDs
methods.description: Finds policies referencing specific field IDs.
